body.name: NuT
body.def: For \(T\ge T_0\) with \(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\ge u_0\), \(\mathcal N_T\) puts a point at \((j\Delta(u_{\mathrm p}(T))/T,\{D(j\Delta(u_{\mathrm p}(T)))-b(T)\}/a(T))\) whenever the level-\(u_{\mathrm p}(T)\) translate of the Palm root rule \(A_u\) holds at \(j\Delta(u_{\mathrm p}(T))\in[0,T]\).
